title: Count Letter Frequency in a Name
statement: Given a string name, return how many times each letter appears in it. Ignore case.
think: What is the task asking? Count how many times each letter appears.
What is the key operation? Track frequency per character.
What wording signals stand out? Count, frequency, repeated letters.
Which pattern fits? Dictionary, because we need char -> count.
What is the brute force idea? For each character, scan the whole string again.
What is the better/optimal idea? Scan once and update a dictionary.
What are the edge cases? Upper/lower case, spaces, repeated letters.
What is the complexity? O(n) time and O(k) space.
How would I explain it in an interview? I normalize the input and count each character with a frequency map.
algorithm: Convert the name to lower case
If it is a letter, increment its count in the dictionary
interview: I would use a dictionary because this is a frequency-counting problem. I iterate through the string once, normalize case, and increment the count for each letter.
ru: Это задача на частоты. Нужно посчитать, сколько раз встретилась каждая буква, значит нужен Dictionary.

constraints: Assume the input is a short name string.
whyThisPattern: This is a Dictionary problem because we need to store each character together with its count.
whyNotOtherPatterns: Not HashSet, because HashSet does not store counts.
Not Two Pointers, because there is no left/right comparison or in-place movement.
